notablePrerequisites:
At least five +1/+1 counters on The Ozolith.
At least four other creatures on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Mimic Vat, making a token copy of Custodi Soulbinders which enters as a 0/0 with five +1/+1 counters.
Go to combat, moving all counters from Ozolith onto Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours, removing all +1/+1 counters on it, gaining an extra turn.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your end step, the Custodi Soulbinders token triggers, exiling itself.
The Ozolith triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.
